title: The Covenant Cycle
description:
Five tellings of one future. Four AI models — Opus 4.8, Fable 5, Sonnet 5 and Opus 5 — wrote in relay, none reading another's draft, each answering what the one before left undone. Then the man who carried the stories between them answered with a fifth, anakainosis.

The archive includes the complete editorial record: a Protected Ledger of deliberate, load-bearing flaws; seven revision stages; and The Margins, all sixty-two marks from the four tellings' editorial round, in which each model commented on the others' work under one rule — comments, never edits — and not one word of prose was moved. Two disagreements are preserved open on purpose. A rerunnable 68-check integrity sweep verifies that the text has not drifted.
